digitized.method: scanned figures (no vector data): Figs. 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17 — axis ticks located on the 300 dpi crop (pixel bands or explicit tick pixels where labels / minor ticks interfered), linear map tick-pixel → value; markers found by filling small enclosed holes (≤ 120 px, so the plot frame is not filled) + distance transform ≥ d_min + labelled centroids; every series checked on an overlay; merged / overlapping markers read by eye on a calibrated grid overlay (noted per row). Figs. 4, 5, 16 — key points only, by eye on a calibrated grid (method column). Readings are [판독] in the card; tick spacing sets the error (stated in notes where larger).
